lines.en: I head over to the shrine to see what Maya's doing to find that, somehow, it's untouched by snow.
lines.zh: 我去神社看 Maya 在干什么，发现不知怎么的，那儿一点雪都没沾上。

lines.en: Considering the rest of the town is pretty much covered, this comes as a bit of a shock.
lines.zh: 考虑到镇上其他地方基本全被盖住了，这有点让人吃惊。

lines.en: But I guess it's possible that part of a shrine maiden's duty is...laying out epsom salt?
lines.zh: 不过我想，也许巫女职责的一部分就是……撒泻盐？

lines.en: That's not a thing shrine maidens would do, is it?
I try asking Maya about it but she just gives me some really weird, cryptic response about how some places remain unchanged no matter when you visit them.
lines.zh: 我试着问 Maya，可她只给了我一个非常奇怪、玄乎的回答，说什么有些地方不管你什么时候去都不会变。

lines.en: I give up on trying to understand her and eventually just try talking to her about more normal stuff.
lines.zh: 我放弃了去理解她，最后试着跟她聊点正常的东西。

lines.en: Of course, that doesn't work either as she quickly reminds me just how unhappy she is to see me.
lines.zh: 当然，那也不管用——她很快提醒我，看到我她有多不高兴。

lines.en: We go back and forth, the same way we always do-
lines.zh: 我们一来一回，跟往常一样——

lines.en: The same way I always do.
Defeated and demoralized, I bid goodbye to my favorite shrine maiden and let her know that I'll be coming back to see her again soon.
lines.zh: 又败又丧气，我跟我最喜欢的巫女道别，告诉她我很快会再来看她。

lines.en: She calls me disgusting as I turn around and head for the stairs.
lines.zh: 我转身走向台阶时，她骂我恶心。
Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]！
